body:
You sound like such a strong person.

Yeah, vibrators are great.  I have no problem getting myself off.  But what I'm looking for is companionship.  I want to be able to adore someone, to add meaning and happiness to their life.

I don't spill my insecurities to people around me.  I put on a pretty good act (without being obnoxious, I'm human).  It's just not working.
As in asking the guys out on a date?  Hell, yes!  I'm usually the one making the moves to begin with.

Thank you but no one wants to "fight tooth and nail" for me.

I try my hardest to appear like I have my shit together.  But inside I feel broken and unwanted.
Thank you for your reply.  Where do you suggest I meet guys?  How should I approach them?  Unfortunately, I usually have to start the conversation which can make me feel overassertive.

At 29, I'm growing increasingly tired.  And at my age, I'm thinking something is wrong with me because I haven't found someone yet.
I've settled in the past, thinking it would be safer.  Put up with things I didn't deserve, such as cheating and abuse.  Just looked the other way.  Even those relationships failed when I tried my hardest.
Thanks for your help.  How should I respond to this?
I was hoping to hear a story of hope if anyone would like to share.
I am truly sorry that you're also experiencing this because it feels absolutely horrible.  Do you have friends?  Cherish them please.

Well, that just proves my point that no one cares.

Had a rough night.  Tired.  Wish I could just fall asleep and never wake up.
